description: Real-model behaviour of the extraction prompt on the three smoke messages (scripts/llm_smoke.py). Evidence for the M17 report; historical data, not asserted by tests.

runs.notes: Filled transaction_id (TRX-SMOKE-1, TRX-SMOKE-2) although the customer neither gave it nor picked a shown candidate. es_unrecognized transaction_date = 2026-06-16.

Aliases instead of internal IDs: no transaction_id proposed, zero discards. Regression: es_unrecognized transaction_date = null although the customer said 'del 16 de junio'. Fixed in extract@1.4.0 by resolving the year in code.
transaction_date as {day, month, year|null}, year completed in code: es_unrecognized transaction_date = 2026-06-16 again. No transaction_id proposed.

Both dates as {day, month, year|null}. es_unrecognized: model returned {16, 6, null}, completed in code to 2026-06-16. es_not_received_legal: delivery {1, 6, 2026} -> 2026-06-01. No transaction_id proposed, no adjustments. Fixtures in tests/fixtures/llm/ were recorded in this run.

Adds the 'withdrawn' confirmation and the duplicate_ref yes/no question. The three first-message cases are unchanged from 1.5.0. Extract latency rose from 3.3-3.8 s to 4.6-6.4 s with ~230 more input tokens. Confirmation cases (six replies to a pending question) are added to scripts/llm_smoke.py; their results are recorded with the next --record run. Over the later runs with the confirmation cases, extract latency ranged from 2.8 to 9.8 s.

by_prompt_version.description: Input tokens and extract latency per extraction prompt version (smoke runs). Before adding instructions in a new version, check whether an existing one can be removed (see app/llm_adapter/prompts.py).

pending_for_m18: Measure p50 and p95 of the whole turn with and without LLM_CONNECT_ENABLED; single smoke runs are not enough to describe a latency this variable.
